title: The tokens didn't disappear. They were escrowed.

intent.expected: Mint a complete set, rest SELL_YES inventory, then recover the exact inventory when the resting order is cancelled.

venueReality.summary: Visible YES fell to zero while the order rested because the outcome token was held in venue escrow. Exact cancel restored the visible inventory, then burnSet returned the collateral.

reconciliation.finalState: YES/NO returned to zero after burnSet and tUSDC returned to the original raw balance.

limitations: This implementation replays captured evidence; it did not originate these writes.
This fixture proves venue escrow semantics, not incident prevalence.
